mentions.h: DECEMBER 26th - BOXING DAY HANDICAP MEETING - BATTERSEA PARK.
WELCOME TO THE FOLLOWING NEW MEMBERS
MARCH 3rd 1973 - BATTERSEA PARK - SOUTHERN AREA R.W.A. MEETING.
Olympic Cup goes to Stuart Bennett
mentions.note: won the junior 5 mile walk championship (Olympic Cup), 46:56

mentions.h: Holmes first for Bels in Southern
mentions.note: 171st Southern Counties C.C. Championships junior race; on loan from the walking section
14th in junior/youth race, 27:06; 6th in LPR 9km yacht handicap, 46:50

photos.c: Right: Two more youngsters who turned out for the Belgrave Open. George Beecham and Stuart Bennett find time to smile for the camera-man in spite of facing the climb up Cambridge Road.

Right: Track Judges Tony Fairclough, Natalie Stracey and Pat Mead are regaled with another amusing anecdote from Stuart Bennett (seated), or is he making some caustic comment about the timekeeper in unaccustomed shades - Cecil Gittins

The officials, pictured left, were (from the top left to right): Gordon Biscoe (timekeeper), John Sullivan (North London timekeeper), Don Anderson (timekeeper), Yak Stegner (Herne Hill timekeeper), Terry Earle (timekeeper), Pat Mead (track referee), Stuart Bennett (track judge), Bob Bridges (timekeeper), Richard Biscoe (track judge), Alan Mead (chief timekeeper), Leslie Earle (track judge). Not pictured but recording entries and assisting with the seeding was John Jeffery while starter was Bob Bush (Serpentine).
